documents.label: system.yaml
documents.text:
format: ess/1
system: demo
version: v1
domains:
  - demo.core

documents.label: core.yaml
documents.text:
domain: demo.core
events:
  - name: demo.core.Fired
    fields:
      - name: value
        type: String
commands:
  - name: demo.core.Fire
    outcomes:
      - name: done
        emits:
          - demo.core.Fired

documents.label: wiring.yaml
documents.text:
components:
  - component: worker
    owns:
      domains:
        - demo.core
    accepts:
      commands:
        - demo.core.Fire
    publishes:
      events:
        - demo.core.Fired
